description: This file defines the ListViewSearchParams class which extends BaseParam. It provides methods to retrieve the module name and configure parameters using Symfony's OptionsResolver. It appears to be part of an API parameter handling system within SuiteCRM, specifically related to list view search parameters.

classes.name: ListViewSearchParams
classes.description: A class that manages search parameters for list views in the API, providing methods to access module name and configure parameters.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name parameter from the parameters array.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures the parameter options using Symfony's OptionsResolver, specifically setting the 'moduleName' option.
